Method of Attack: Loads malicious code from C2 servers using domain generation algorithms
Modifies operating system timed jobs and scripts (cronjob, init scripts)
Prevents firmware updates by overwriting update sources
Prevents QNAP MalwareRemover App from running
Retrieves and sends all usernames and passwords to C2 server
Modular capacity to load new features from C2 servers
Call-home activity to C2 servers at set intervals
Discoverer: National Cyber Security Centre of Finland (NCSC-FI)
